add_or_subtract_time.description: Add days, hours, minutes and seconds to a date and time, or subtract them, in a time zone: for example 3 days and 4 hours from now in Tokyo. Leave the start empty to start from the current time. Time is counted as it passes, so across a clock change the result's clock time shifts by the hour that was skipped or repeated. No API key required.

description: Get the current time anywhere: in any time zone, at a place on the map or for a visitor's IP address. Convert a date and time between time zones with daylight saving time handled, add or subtract days and hours, find the day of the week or of the year for a date, look up a time zone's offsets and daylight saving dates, and write dates out in 134 languages. No account or API key required.
